## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

## Query parameters

upsertstringOptional

Allow override of environment variable if it already exists

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

Option 1Option 2

keystringRequired

The name of the environment variable

valuestringRequired

The value of the environment variable

typestringRequired

The type of environment variable

+Show 4 enum values

targetarrayOptional

The target environment of the environment variable

gitBranchstringOptional

If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

commentstringOptional

A comment to add context on what this environment variable is for

customEnvironmentIdsarrayOptional

The custom environment IDs associated with the environment variable

## Response

201The environment variable was created successfully

createdobjectRequired

+Show 22 properties

failedarrayRequired

+Show 1 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid. The environment variable coudn't be created because an ongoing update env update is already happening The environment variable coudn't be created because project document is too large

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource. The environment variable cannot be created because it already exists

404Error

409Error

429Error

500Error

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

idstringRequired

The unique ID for the environment variable to get the decrypted value.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

Variant 1Variant 2

decryptedbooleanRequired

+Show 2 enum values

typestringRequired

+Show 5 enum values

edgeConfigIdstringOptional

edgeConfigTokenIdstringOptional

createdAtnumberOptional

updatedAtnumberOptional

idstringOptional

keystringRequired

targetobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

gitBranchstringOptional

createdBystringOptional

updatedBystringOptional

sunsetSecretIdstringOptional

This is used to identify variables that have been migrated from type secret to sensitive.

legacyValuestringOptional

Legacy now-encryption ciphertext, present after migration swaps value/vsmValue

configurationIdstringOptional

contentHintobjectOptional17 variants

+Show 17 variants

internalContentHintobjectOptional

Similar to `contentHints`, but should not be exposed to the user.

+Show 2 properties

commentstringOptional

customEnvironmentIdsarrayOptional

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

Remove an environment variable

# Remove an environment variable

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/{idOrName}/env/{id}`

Delete a specific environment variable for a given project by passing the environment variable identifier and either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/{idOrName}/env/{id}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/idOrName/env/id?customEnvironmentId=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'DELETE',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

idstringRequired

The unique environment variable identifier

## Query parameters

customEnvironmentIdstringOptional

The unique custom environment identifier within the project

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200The environment variable was successfully removed

Variant 1Variant 2Variant 3

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409The project is being transfered and removing an environment variable is not possible

# Edit an environment variable

PATCH`https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/{idOrName}/env/{id}`

Edit a specific environment variable for a given project by passing the environment variable identifier and either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

idstringRequired

The unique environment variable identifier

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

keystringOptional

The name of the environment variable

targetarrayOptional

The target environment of the environment variable

gitBranchstringOptional

If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

typestringOptional

The type of environment variable

+Show 4 enum values

valuestringOptional

The value of the environment variable

customEnvironmentIdsarrayOptional

The custom environments that the environment variable should be synced to

commentstringOptional

A comment to add context on what this env var is for

## Response

200The environment variable was successfully edited

typestringRequired

+Show 5 enum values

valuestringRequired

edgeConfigIdstringOptional

edgeConfigTokenIdstringOptional

createdAtnumberOptional

updatedAtnumberOptional

idstringOptional

keystringRequired

targetobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

gitBranchstringOptional

createdBystringOptional

updatedBystringOptional

sunsetSecretIdstringOptional

This is used to identify variables that have been migrated from type secret to sensitive.

legacyValuestringOptional

Legacy now-encryption ciphertext, present after migration swaps value/vsmValue

decryptedbooleanOptional

+Show 2 enum values

configurationIdstringOptional

contentHintobjectOptional17 variants

+Show 17 variants

internalContentHintobjectOptional

Similar to `contentHints`, but should not be exposed to the user.

+Show 2 properties

commentstringOptional

customEnvironmentIdsarrayOptional

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid. At least one environment variable failed validation

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409The project is being transfered and removing an environment variable is not possible

429Error

500Error

# Batch remove environment variables

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/env`

Delete multiple environment variables for a given project in a single batch operation.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/env
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/idOrName/env?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'DELETE',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    {
    
    2
    
      "deleted": "123",
    
    3
    
      "ids": []
    
    4
    
    }

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

idsarrayRequired

Array of environment variable IDs to delete

## Response

200Success

deletednumberRequired

idsarrayRequired

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

Create project transfer request

# Create project transfer request

POST`https://api.vercel.com/projects/{idOrName}/transfer-request`

Initiates a project transfer request from one team to another.   
Returns a `code` that remains valid for 24 hours and can be used to accept the transfer request by another team using the `PUT /projects/transfer-request/:code` endpoint.   
Users can also accept the project transfer request using the claim URL: `https://vercel.com/claim-deployment?code=<code>&returnUrl=<returnUrl>`.   
The `code` parameter specifies the project transfer request code generated using this endpoint.   
The `returnUrl` parameter redirects users to a specific page of the application if the claim URL is invalid or expired.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/projects/{idOrName}/transfer-request
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/projects/idOrName/transfer-request?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
      body: JSON.stringify({
    
    8
    
        "callbackUrl": "https://example.com",
    
    9
    
        "callbackSecret": "string"
    
    10
    
      }),
    
    11
    
    });
    
    12
    
    
    
    
    13
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    14
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    {
    
    2
    
      "code": "f99cc49a-602e-4786-a748-762dfb205880"
    
    3
    
    }

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The ID or name of the project to transfer.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

callbackUrlstringOptional

The URL to send a webhook to when the transfer is accepted.

callbackSecretstringOptional

The secret to use to sign the webhook payload with HMAC-SHA256.

## Response

200The project transfer request has been initiated successfully.

codestringRequired

Code that can be used to accept the project transfer request.

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

The unique project identifier or the project name

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

revokeobjectOptional

Optional instructions for revoking and regenerating a automation bypass

+Show 2 properties

generateobjectOptional

Generate a new secret. If neither generate or revoke are provided, a new random secret will be generated.

+Show 2 properties

updateobjectOptional

Update an existing bypass

+Show 3 properties

## Response

200Success

protectionBypassobjectOptional

## Errors

Point production traffic to a previous production deployment by ID

# Point production traffic to a previous production deployment by ID

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/rollback/{deploymentId}`

Allows users to rollback to a deployment.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/rollback/{deploymentId}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/projectId/rollback/deploymentId?description=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    {}

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

projectIdstringRequired

deploymentIdstringRequired

The ID of the deployment to rollback _to_

## Query parameters

descriptionstringOptional

The reason for the rollback

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

201Success

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

409Error

422Error

# Updates the description for a rollback

PATCH`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/rollback/{deploymentId}/update-description`

Updates the reason for a rollback, without changing the rollback status itself.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/rollback/{deploymentId}/update-description
    
    
    1

    2

    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
      body: JSON.stringify({
    
    8
    
        "description": "string"
    
    9
    
      }),
    
    10
    
    });
    
    11
    
    
    
    
    12
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    13
    
    console.log(data);

    1
    
    {}

projectIdstringRequired

deploymentIdstringRequired

## Body

application/json

descriptionstringOptional

The reason for the rollback

## Response

200Success

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

409Error

422Error

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

projectIdstringRequired

The unique project identifier

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

microfrontendsGroupIdstringOptional

The unique group identifier to add this microfrontend to

enabledbooleanOptional

Enable or disable microfrontends for the project

isDefaultAppbooleanOptional

Whether the application is the default application for the microfrontends group

defaultRoutestringOptional

The default route used for screenshots and preview links for the project

routeObservabilityToThisProjectbooleanOptional

Whether observability data should be routed to this project or a root project. Can only be set for child applications.

doNotRouteWithMicrofrontendsRoutingbooleanOptional

Whether domains in this project should route as a microfrontend. Can only be set for child applications.

Point production traffic to a given deployment

# Point production traffic to a given deployment

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v10/projects/{projectId}/promote/{deploymentId}`

Allows users to promote a deployment to production. Note: This does NOT rebuild the deployment. If you need that, then call create-deployments endpoint.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v10/projects/{projectId}/promote/{deploymentId}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v10/projects/projectId/promote/deploymentId?teamId=string&slug=string', {

Response
    
    
    1
    
    {}

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

projectIdstringRequired

deploymentIdstringRequired

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

201Success

202Success

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

409Error

# Gets a list of aliases with status for the current promote

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/promote/aliases`

Get a list of aliases related to the last promote request with their mapping status

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/promote/aliases
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/projectId/promote/aliases?limit=123&since=123&until=123&failedOnly=true&teamId=string&slug=string', {

    1
    
    "value"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

projectIdstringRequired

## Query parameters

limitnumberOptional

Maximum number of aliases to list from a request (max 100).

sincenumberOptional

Get aliases created after this epoch timestamp.

untilnumberOptional

Get aliases created before this epoch timestamp.

failedOnlybooleanOptional

Filter results down to aliases that failed to map to the requested deployment

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

Variant 1Variant 2

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

Pause a project

# Pause a project

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/pause`

Pause a project by passing its project `id` in the URL. If the project does not exist given the id then the request will fail with 400 status code. If the project disables auto assigning custom production domains and blocks the active Production Deployment then the request will return with 200 status code.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{projectId}/pause

    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

    1
    
    {}

Default authentication mechanism

slugstringOptional

## Response

200Success

## Errors

401The request is not authorized.

500Error

# Get rolling release billing status

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/billing`

Get the Rolling Releases billing status for a project. The team level billing status is used to determine if the project can be configured for rolling releases.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/billing
    
    
    1

    3

    4

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

Project ID or project name (URL-encoded)

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

Variant 1Variant 2Variant 3Variant 4

availableSlotsnumberRequired

+Show 1 enum values

reasonstringRequired

+Show 1 enum values

messagestringRequired

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

Get rolling release configuration

# Get rolling release configuration

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config`

Get the Rolling Releases configuration for a project. The project-level config is simply a template that will be used for any future rolling release, and not the configuration for any active rolling release.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config

Delete rolling release configuration

# Delete rolling release configuration

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config`

Disable Rolling Releases for a project means that future deployments will not undergo a rolling release. Changing the config never alters a rollout that's already in-flight—it only affects the next production deployment. If you want to also stop the current rollout, call this endpoint to disable the feature, and then call either the /complete or /abort endpoint.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config

idOrNamestringRequired

Project ID or project name (URL-encoded)

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

200Success

Update the rolling release settings for the project

# Update the rolling release settings for the project

PATCH`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config`

Update (or disable) Rolling Releases for a project. When disabling with the resolve-on-disable feature flag enabled, any active rolling release document is resolved using the disableRolloutAction parameter: "abort" to roll back (default), or "complete" to promote the canary to production. When enabling or updating config, changes only affect the next production deployment and do not alter a rollout that's already in-flight. Note: Enabling Rolling Releases automatically enables skew protection on the project with the default value if it wasn't configured already.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

    2

    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8

Get the active rolling release information for a project

# Get the active rolling release information for a project

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release`

Return the Rolling Release for a project, regardless of whether the rollout is active, aborted, or completed. If the feature is enabled but no deployment has occurred yet, null will be returned.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

Project ID or project name (URL-encoded)

## Query parameters

statestringOptional

Filter by rolling release state

+Show 3 enum values

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

rollingReleaseobjectRequired

Rolling release information including configuration and document details, or null if no rolling release exists

+Show 12 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

# Update the active rolling release to the next stage for a project

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/approve-stage`

Advance a rollout to the next stage. This is only needed when rolling releases is configured to require manual approval.

canaryDeploymentIdstringRequired

The id of the canary deployment to approve for the next stage

## Response

200Success

rollingReleaseobjectRequired

Rolling release information including configuration and document details, or null if no rolling release exists

+Show 12 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

500Error

Start a rolling release for the project

# Start a rolling release for the project

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/start`

Start a rolling release for a deployment. If a rolling release is already active for the same canary deployment, returns the current state without side effects.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

Project ID or project name (URL-encoded)

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

canaryDeploymentIdstringRequired

The ID of the canary deployment to start the rolling release for

## Response

200Success

rollingReleaseobjectRequired

Rolling release information including configuration and document details, or null if no rolling release exists

+Show 12 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

422Error

# Complete the rolling release for the project

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/complete`

Force-complete a Rolling Release. The canary deployment will begin serving 100% of the traffic.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

idOrNamestringRequired

Project ID or project name (URL-encoded)

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

canaryDeploymentIdstringRequired

The ID of the canary deployment to complete

## Response

200Success

rollingReleaseobjectRequired

Rolling release information including configuration and document details, or null if no rolling release exists

+Show 12 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

# List sandboxes

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes`

Retrieves a paginated list of named sandboxes belonging to a specific project. Results can be sorted by creation time or name, and optionally filtered by name prefix.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes

    2
    
      method: 'GET',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectstringOptional

The unique identifier or name of the project to list named sandboxes for.

limitnumberOptional

Maximum number of named sandboxes to return in the response. Used for pagination.

sortBystringOptional

Field to sort by.

+Show 4 enum values

namePrefixstringOptional

Filter named sandboxes whose name starts with this prefix. Only valid when sortBy=name.

cursorstringOptional

Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortOrderstringOptional

Sort direction. Defaults to desc.

+Show 2 enum values

tagsanyOptional

Filter sandboxes by tag. Format: "key:value". Only one tag filter is supported at a time.

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

sandboxesarrayRequired

+Show 23 properties

paginationobjectRequired

+Show 2 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes`

Creates a named sandbox environment. Named sandboxes have a unique name within a project and support automatic snapshotting on shutdown.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

networkPolicyobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

imagestringOptional

Image to use for the sandbox.

resourcesobjectOptional

Resources to define the VM

+Show 2 properties

runtimestringOptional

The runtime environment for the sandbox. Determines the pre-installed language runtimes and tools available.

+Show 4 enum values

sourceobjectOptional3 variants

+Show 3 variants

projectIdstringOptional

The target project slug or ID in which the sandbox will be assigned to.

portsarrayOptional

List of ports to expose from the sandbox. Each port will be accessible via a unique URL. Maximum of 15 ports can be exposed.

timeoutintegerOptional

Maximum duration in milliseconds that the sandbox can run before being automatically stopped.

envobjectOptional

Default environment variables for the sandbox. These are inherited by all commands unless overridden.

mountsobjectOptional

List of drives to mount to the sandbox at the provided path.

namestringOptional

Name for the sandbox. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

persistentbooleanOptional

Whether the sandbox persists its state across restarts via automatic snapshots. Defaults to true.

snapshotExpirationobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

keepLastSnapshotsobjectOptional

Protect the N most recent snapshots with different expiration/deletion behavior.

+Show 3 properties

tagsobjectOptional

Key-value tags to associate with the sandbox. Maximum 5 tags.

## Response

200Success

sandboxobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel NamedSandbox.

+Show 23 properties

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

routesarrayRequired

+Show 4 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

410Error

422Error

429The concurrency limit has been exceeded.

500Error

# List drives

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/drives`

Retrieves a paginated list of drives belonging to a specific project. Drives are in private beta. Register your interest to get access: <https://vercel.com/changelog/drives-for-vercel-sandbox-in-private-beta>

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectIdstringOptional

The project ID or name associated with the drives. Required unless using a Vercel OIDC token scoped to a project.

limitnumberOptional

Maximum number of drives to return in the response. Used for pagination.

cursorstringOptional

Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBystringOptional

Field to sort drives by.

+Show 3 enum values

namePrefixstringOptional

Filter drives whose name starts with this prefix. Only valid when sortBy=name.

sortOrderstringOptional

Sort direction for results.

+Show 2 enum values

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

drivesarrayRequired

+Show 7 properties

paginationobjectRequired

+Show 2 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

Get or create a drive

# Get or create a drive

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/drives/{name}`

Gets an existing drive by project and name, or creates it when it does not exist. Drives are in private beta. Register your interest to get access: <https://vercel.com/changelog/drives-for-vercel-sandbox-in-private-beta>

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/drives/{name}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/drives/name?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2

    4

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

namestringRequired

Name for the drive. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

projectIdstringOptional

The project ID or name to associate the drive with. Required unless using a Vercel OIDC token scoped to a project.

maxSizeBytesintegerOptional

Maximum drive size in bytes. Defaults to 100 GiB when omitted.

## Response

200Success

driveobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Drive.

+Show 7 properties

201Success

driveobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Drive.

+Show 7 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

429Error

Delete a drive

# Delete a drive

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/drives/{name}`

Deletes a drive by project and name. Attached drives cannot be deleted. Stop or replace the session currently using the drive before retrying deletion. Drives are in private beta. Register your interest to get access: <https://vercel.com/changelog/drives-for-vercel-sandbox-in-private-beta>

# List snapshots

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots`

Retrieves a paginated list of snapshots for a specific project.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots?project=string&name=string&limit=123&cursor=string&sortOrder=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'GET',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    "value"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectstringOptional

The unique identifier or name of the project to list snapshots for.

namestringOptional

Name for the sandbox. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

limitnumberOptional

Maximum number of snapshots to return in the response. Used for pagination.

cursorstringOptional

Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortOrderstringOptional

Sort direction for results by creation time.

+Show 2 enum values

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

Variant 1Variant 2

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots/{snapshotId}`

Retrieves detailed information about a specific snapshot, including its creation time, size, expiration date, and the source session it was created from.

Delete a snapshot

# Delete a snapshot

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots/{snapshotId}`

Permanently deletes a snapshot and frees its associated storage. This action cannot be undone. After deletion, the snapshot can no longer be used to create new sessions.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots/{snapshotId}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/snapshots/snapshotId?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'DELETE',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

snapshotIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the snapshot to delete.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

snapshotobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Snapshot of a Vercel Sandbox session (v2 API).

+Show 11 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

List sessions

# List sessions

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions`

Retrieves a paginated list of sessions belonging to a specific sandbox. Results are sorted by creation time and paginated using an opaque cursor.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions?project=string&name=string&limit=123&cursor=string&sortOrder=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'GET',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    "value"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectstringOptional

The unique identifier or name of the project to list sessions for.

namestringOptional

Filter sessions by sandbox name. Only sessions belonging to the specified sandbox are returned.

limitnumberOptional

Maximum number of sessions to return in the response. Used for pagination.

cursorstringOptional

Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortOrderstringOptional

Sort direction for results by creation time.

+Show 2 enum values

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200The list of sessions matching the request filters.

Variant 1Variant 2

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

500Error

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions?project=string&name=string&limit=123&cursor=string&sortOrder=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'GET',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    "value"

# Get a session

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}`

Retrieves detailed information about a specific session, including its current status, resource configuration, and exposed routes.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to retrieve.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200The session was retrieved successfully.

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

routesarrayRequired

+Show 4 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

500Error

Get a named sandbox

# Get a named sandbox

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/{name}`

Retrieves a named sandbox by name, including its current sandbox and routes. If the sandbox is stopped and resume is true, a new sandbox will be created from the most recent snapshot.

      "resumed": "false"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

namestringRequired

Name for the sandbox. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

## Query parameters

projectIdstringOptional

The project ID or name (required when not using OIDC token).

resumebooleanOptional

Whether to automatically resume a stopped named sandbox by creating a new instance from its snapshot. Defaults to false.

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

sandboxobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel NamedSandbox.

+Show 23 properties

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

routesarrayRequired

+Show 4 properties

resumedbooleanRequired

+Show 2 enum values

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

410Error

429The concurrency limit has been exceeded.

500Error

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

namestringRequired

The sandbox to update.

## Query parameters

projectIdstringOptional

The project ID that owns the named sandbox. When provided, takes precedence over OIDC project context.

resumebooleanOptional

Whether to automatically resume a stopped named sandbox by creating a new instance from its snapshot. Defaults to false.

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

resourcesobjectOptional

Resources to define the VM

+Show 2 properties

runtimestringOptional

The runtime environment for the sandbox. Determines the pre-installed language runtimes and tools available.

+Show 4 enum values

timeoutintegerOptional

Maximum duration in milliseconds that the sandbox can run before being automatically stopped.

persistentbooleanOptional

Whether the sandbox persists its state across restarts via automatic snapshots.

snapshotExpirationobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

keepLastSnapshotsobjectOptional

+Show 3 properties

networkPolicyobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

envobjectOptional

Default environment variables for the sandbox. Set to empty object to clear.

portsarrayOptional

List of ports to expose from the sandbox. Each port will be accessible via a unique URL. Maximum of 15 ports can be exposed.

currentSnapshotIdstringOptional

The snapshot ID to set as the current snapshot. Must be active and belong to the same project.

tagsobjectOptional

Key-value tags to associate with the sandbox. Replaces existing tags. Set to empty object to clear. Maximum 5 tags.

## Response

200Success

Variant 1Variant 2

routesarrayRequired

+Show 4 properties

sandboxobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel NamedSandbox.

+Show 23 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

409Error

410Error

422Error

429The concurrency limit has been exceeded.

500Error

Delete a sandbox

# Delete a sandbox

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/{name}`

Deletes a sandbox by name. If sandboxes are currently running, they will be stopped first. This operation deletes all sandbox entities with the given name and the named sandbox metadata.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

namestringRequired

The sandbox name to delete.

## Query parameters

projectIdstringOptional

The project ID that owns the named sandbox. When provided, takes precedence over OIDC project context.

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

sandboxobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel NamedSandbox.

+Show 23 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

429Error

# List commands

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd`

Retrieves a list of all commands that have been executed in a session, including their current status, exit codes, and execution times, ordered from the most recent to the oldest.

Execute a command

# Execute a command

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd`

Executes a shell command inside a running session. The command runs asynchronously and returns immediately with a command ID that can be used to track its progress and retrieve its output. Optionally, use the `wait` parameter to stream the command status until completion.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd
    
    
    1

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session in which to execute the command.

## Query parameters

cmdIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the command to stream logs for.

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

commandstringRequired

The executable or shell command to run. This is the program name without arguments.

argsarrayOptional

Arguments to pass to the command. Each argument should be a separate array element.

cwdstringOptional

The working directory in which to execute the command. Defaults to the sandbox home directory if not specified.

envobjectOptional

Additional environment variables to set for this command. These are merged with the sandbox environment.

sudobooleanOptional

Execute the command with root (superuser) privileges.

waitbooleanOptional

If true, returns an ND-JSON stream that emits the command status when started and again when finished. Useful for synchronously waiting for command completion.

logsbooleanOptional

If true, stream the logs of the command execution in real-time via ND-JSON. This is only applicable if `wait` is also true.

timeoutintegerOptional

Maximum duration in milliseconds the command may run before it is killed with SIGKILL. Enforced at exec time, independently of `wait`.

## Response

200Success

commandobjectRequired

This object represents a command run in a Vercel Sandbox session (v2 API).

+Show 7 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Get a command

# Get a command

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}`

Retrieves the current status and details of a command executed in a session. Use the `wait` parameter to block until the command finishes execution.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/sessionId/cmd/cmdId?wait=string&teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'GET',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session containing the command.

cmdIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the command to retrieve.

## Query parameters

waitstringOptional

If set to "true", the request will block until the command finishes execution. Useful for synchronously waiting for command completion.

+Show 2 enum values

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200The command data along with the exit code if the command did finish.

commandobjectRequired

This object represents a command run in a Vercel Sandbox session (v2 API).

+Show 7 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Kill a command

# Kill a command

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/kill`

Sends a signal to terminate a running command in a session. The signal can be used to gracefully stop (SIGTERM) or forcefully kill (SIGKILL) the process. The command must still be running for this operation to succeed.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/kill
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/sessionId/cmd/cmdId/kill?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
      body: JSON.stringify({
    
    8
    
        "signal": "15"
    
    9
    
      }),
    
    10
    
    });
    
    11
    
    
    
    
    12
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    13

      }
    
    11

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

cmdIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the command to terminate.

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session containing the command.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

signalnumberRequired

The POSIX signal number to send to the process. Common values: 15 (SIGTERM) for graceful termination, 9 (SIGKILL) for forced termination.

## Response

200The command was terminated successfully.

commandobjectRequired

This object represents a command run in a Vercel Sandbox session (v2 API).

+Show 7 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Stream command logs

# Stream command logs

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/logs`

Streams the output of a command in real-time using newline-delimited JSON (ND-JSON). Each entry includes the output data and stream type. Stream types include `stdout`, `stderr`, and `error` (for stream failures).

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/logs

sessionIdstringRequired

cmdIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the command to stream logs for.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

Stop a session

# Stop a session

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/stop`

Stops a running session and releases its allocated resources. All running processes within the session will be terminated. This action cannot be undone. A stopped session cannot be restarted.

Extend session timeout

# Extend session timeout

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/extend-timeout`

Extends the maximum execution time of a running session. The session must be active and able to accept commands. The total timeout cannot exceed the maximum allowed limit for your account.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to extend the timeout for.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

durationnumberRequired

The amount of time in milliseconds to add to the current timeout. Must be at least 1000ms (1 second).

## Response

200The session timeout was extended successfully.

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Update network policy

# Update network policy

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/network-policy`

Replaces the network access policy of a running session. Use this to control which external hosts the session can communicate with. This is a full replacement. Any previously configured network rules will be overwritten.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to update the network policy for.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

Option 1Option 2

modestringRequired

The network access policy mode. Use "allow-all" to permit all outbound traffic. Use "deny-all" to block all outbound traffic. Use "custom" to specify explicit allow/deny rules.

+Show 5 enum values

allowedDomainsarrayOptional

List of domain names the sandbox is allowed to connect to. Only applies when mode is "custom". Supports wildcard patterns (e.g., "*.example.com" matches all subdomains).

allowedCIDRsarrayOptional

List of IP address ranges (in CIDR notation) the sandbox is allowed to connect to. Traffic to these addresses bypasses domain-based restrictions.

deniedCIDRsarrayOptional

List of IP address ranges (in CIDR notation) the sandbox is blocked from connecting to. These rules take precedence over all allowed rules.

injectionRulesarrayOptional

HTTP header injection rules for outgoing requests matching specific domains. Traffic to matching domains will be intercepted instead of proxied through encrypted connections.

+Show 3 properties

## Response

200The session network policy was updated successfully.

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Read a file

# Read a file

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/read`

Downloads the contents of a file from a session's filesystem. The file content is returned as a binary stream with appropriate Content-Disposition headers for file download.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to read the file from.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

cwdstringOptional

The base directory for resolving relative paths. If not specified, paths are resolved from the sandbox home directory.

pathstringRequired

The path of the file to read. Can be absolute or relative to the working directory.

## Response

200Success

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

Create a directory

# Create a directory

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/mkdir`

Creates a new directory in a session's filesystem. By default, parent directories are created recursively if they don't exist (similar to `mkdir -p`).

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/mkdir
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/sessionId/fs/mkdir?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
      body: JSON.stringify({
    
    8
    
        "cwd": "/home/vercel-sandbox",
    
    9
    
        "path": "src/components",
    
    10
    
        "recursive": "true"
    
    11
    
      }),
    
    12
    
    });
    
    13
    
    
    
    
    14
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    15
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    "value"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to create the directory in.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

cwdstringOptional

The base directory for resolving relative paths. If not specified, paths are resolved from the sandbox home directory.

pathstringRequired

The path of the directory to create. Can be absolute or relative to the working directory.

recursivebooleanOptional

If true, creates parent directories as needed (like `mkdir -p`). If false, fails if parent directories do not exist.

## Response

200The directory was created successfully.

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/mkdir

      headers: {

Write files

# Write files

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/write`

Uploads and extracts files to a session's filesystem. Files must be uploaded as a gzipped tarball (`.tar.gz`) with the `Content-Type` header set to `application/gzip`. The tarball contents are extracted to the session's working directory, or to a custom directory specified via the `x-cwd` header.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/write
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/sessionId/fs/write?teamId=string&slug=string', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
    });
    
    8
    
    
    
    
    9
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    10
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    "value"

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to write files to.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Header parameters

'x-Cwd'stringOptional

The target directory where the tarball contents will be extracted. If not specified, files are extracted to the sandbox home directory.

## Response

200The files were successfully written to the session.

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid. One of the provided values in the headers is invalid

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/fs/write

    2

    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',

    8

    10
    
    console.log(data);

    1
    
    "value"

Create a snapshot

# Create a snapshot

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/snapshot`

Creates a point-in-time snapshot of a running session's filesystem. Snapshots can be used to quickly restore a session to a previous state or to create new sessions with pre-configured environments. The session must be running and able to accept commands for a snapshot to be created. The session will be terminated after the snapshot is created.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

sessionIdstringRequired

The unique identifier of the session to snapshot.

## Query parameters

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

expirationobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

## Response

201Success

snapshotobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Snapshot of a Vercel Sandbox session (v2 API).

+Show 11 properties

sessionobjectRequired

This object contains information related to a Vercel Sandbox Session. v2 endpoints return "session" instead of "sandbox" as the response wrapper key.

+Show 23 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402The account is missing a payment so payment method must be updated

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

410Error

422Error

429Error

500Error

# Update Attack Challenge mode

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/attack-mode`

Update the setting for determining if the project has Attack Challenge mode enabled.

# Put Firewall Configuration

PUT`https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/firewall/config`

Set the firewall configuration to provided rules and settings. Creates or overwrite the existing firewall configuration.

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectIdstringRequired

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

firewallEnabledbooleanRequired

managedRulesobjectOptional

crsobjectOptional

Custom Ruleset

+Show 11 properties

rulesarrayOptional

+Show 8 properties

ipsarrayOptional

+Show 5 properties

botIdEnabledbooleanOptional

logHeadersobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

## Response

200Success

activeobjectRequired

+Show 13 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

500Error

# Update Firewall Configuration

PATCH`https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/firewall/config`

Process updates to modify the existing firewall config for a project

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectIdstringRequired

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Body

application/json

Option 1Option 2Option 3Option 4Option 5Option 6Option 7Option 8Option 9Option 10Option 11Option 12Option 13Option 14

actionstringRequired

+Show 1 enum values

idobjectOptional

valuebooleanRequired

## Response

200Success

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

500Error

Read Firewall Configuration

# Read Firewall Configuration

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/firewall/config/{configVersion}`

Retrieve the specified firewall configuration for a project. The deployed configVersion will be `active`

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

configVersionstringRequired

The deployed configVersion for the firewall configuration

## Query parameters

projectIdstringRequired

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200If the firewall configuration includes a [custom managed ruleset](https://vercel.com/docs/security/vercel-waf/managed-rulesets), it will include a `crs` item that has the following values: sd: Scanner Detection ma: Multipart Attack lfi: Local File Inclusion Attack rfi: Remote File Inclusion Attack rce: Remote Execution Attack php: PHP Attack gen: Generic Attack xss: XSS Attack sqli: SQL Injection Attack sf: Session Fixation Attack java: Java Attack

ownerIdstringRequired

projectKeystringRequired

idstringRequired

versionnumberRequired

updatedAtstringRequired

firewallEnabledbooleanRequired

+Show 2 enum values

crsobjectOptional

Custom Ruleset

+Show 11 properties

rulesarrayRequired

+Show 8 properties

ipsarrayRequired

+Show 5 properties

changesarrayRequired

managedRulesobjectOptional

+Show 5 properties

botIdEnabledbooleanOptional

+Show 2 enum values

logHeadersobjectOptional2 variants

+Show 2 variants

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

# Read active attack data

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/security/firewall/attack-status`

Retrieve active attack data within the last N days (default: 1 day)

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Query parameters

projectIdstringRequired

limitnumberOptional

sourceIpstringOptional

Filter by source IP

domainstringOptional

Filter by domain

projectScopebooleanOptional

Filter by project scoped rules

offsetstringOptional

Used for pagination. Retrieves results after the provided id

teamIdstringOptional

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

resultarrayRequired

+Show 14 properties

paginationobjectOptional

+Show 2 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

500Error

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

teamIdstringRequired

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

## Query parameters

limitnumberOptional

Limit how many teams should be returned

sincenumberOptional

Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added since then.

untilnumberOptional

Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added until then.

searchstringOptional

Search team members by their name, username, and email.

rolestringOptional

Only return members with the specified team role.

+Show 8 enum values

excludeProjectstringOptional

Exclude members who belong to the specified project.

eligibleMembersForProjectIdstringOptional

Include team members who are eligible to be members of the specified project.

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

membersarrayRequired

+Show 15 properties

emailInviteCodesarrayOptional

+Show 11 properties

paginationobjectRequired

+Show 4 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

# Invite a user

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v2/teams/{teamId}/members`

Invite a user to join the team specified in the URL. The authenticated user needs to be an `OWNER` in order to successfully invoke this endpoint. The user to be invited must be specified by email.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v2/teams/{teamId}/members
    
    
    1

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

teamIdstringRequired

The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

## Query parameters

slugstringOptional

The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

## Response

200Success

uidstringRequired

The ID of the invited user

usernamestringRequired

The username of the invited user

emailstringRequired

The email of the invited user.

rolestringRequired

The role used for the invitation

+Show 8 enum values

teamRolesarrayOptional

The team roles of the user

teamPermissionsarrayOptional

The team permissions of the user

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid.

401The request is not authorized.

403You do not have permission to access this resource. The authenticated user must be a team owner to perform the action

503Error

# Request access to a team

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/request`

Request access to a team as a member. An owner has to approve the request. Only 100 users can request access to a team at the same time.

Get access request status

# Get access request status

GET`https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/request/{userId}`

Check the status of a join request. It'll respond with a 404 if the request has been declined. If no `userId` path segment was provided, this endpoint will instead return the status of the authenticated user.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

userIdstringRequired

teamIdstringRequired

## Response

200Successfully

teamSlugstringRequired

The slug of the team.

teamNamestringRequired

The name of the team.

confirmedbooleanRequired

Current status of the membership. Will be `true` if confirmed, if pending it'll be `false`.

+Show 2 enum values

joinedFromobjectRequired

A map that describes the origin from where the user joined.

+Show 11 properties

accessRequestedAtnumberRequired

Timestamp in milliseconds when the user requested access to the team.

githubobjectRequired

Map of the connected GitHub account.

+Show 1 properties

gitlabobjectRequired

Map of the connected GitLab account.

+Show 1 properties

bitbucketobjectRequired

Map of the connected Bitbucket account.

+Show 1 properties

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request query is invalid. User is already a confirmed member of the team and did not request access. Only visible when the authenticated user does have access to the team.

401Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404The provided user doesn't have a membership. Team was not found.

Join a team

# Join a team

POST`https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/teams/join`

Join a team with a provided invite code or team ID.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/teams/join
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/teamId/members/teams/join', {
    
    2
    
      method: 'POST',
    
    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7
    
      body: JSON.stringify({
    
    8
    
        "inviteCode": "fisdh38aejkeivn34nslfore9vjtn4ls"
    
    9
    
      }),
    
    10
    
    });
    
    11
    
    
    
    
    12
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    13
    
    console.log(data);

Response
    
    
    1
    
    {
    
    2
    
      "teamId": "team_LLHUOMOoDlqOp8wPE4kFo9pE",
    
    3
    
      "slug": "my-team",
    
    4
    
      "name": "My Team",
    
    5
    
      "from": "email"
    
    6
    
    }

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

teamIdstringRequired

## Body

application/json

inviteCodestringOptional

The invite code to join the team.

## Response

200Successfully joined a team.

teamIdstringRequired

The ID of the team the user joined.

slugstringRequired

The slug of the team the user joined.

namestringRequired

The name of the team the user joined.

fromstringRequired

The origin of how the user joined.

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid.

401Error

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404Error

503Error

Update a Team Member

# Update a Team Member

PATCH`https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}`

Update the membership of a Team Member on the Team specified by `teamId`, such as changing the _role_ of the member, or confirming a request to join the Team for an unconfirmed member. The authenticated user must be an `OWNER` of the Team.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}

    3

    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5

## Authentication

AuthorizationbearerToken

Default authentication mechanism

## Path parameters

uidstringRequired

The ID of the member.

teamIdstringRequired

## Body

application/json

confirmedbooleanOptional

Accept a user who requested access to the team.

+Show 1 enum values

rolestringOptional

The role in the team of the member.

teamPermissionsarrayOptional

The team permissions to set for the member. Permissions must be compatible with the team roles assigned to the member.

projectsarrayOptional

+Show 2 properties

joinedFromobjectOptional

+Show 1 properties

## Response

200Successfully updated the membership.

idstringRequired

ID of the team.

## Errors

400One of the provided values in the request body is invalid. One of the provided values in the request query is invalid. Cannot disconnect SSO from a Team member that does not have a SSO connection. Cannot confirm a member that is already confirmed. Cannot confirm a member that did not request access.

401The request is not authorized. Team members can only be updated by an owner, or by the authenticated user if they are only disconnecting their SAML connection to the Team.

402Error

403You do not have permission to access this resource.

404The provided user is not part of this team. A user with the specified ID does not exist.

409Error

500Error

Remove a Team Member

# Remove a Team Member

DEL`https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}`

Remove a Team Member from the Team, or dismiss a user that requested access, or leave a team.

TypeScriptNext.jscURL

https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/{teamId}/members/{uid}
    
    
    1
    
    const response = await fetch('https://api.vercel.com/v1/teams/teamId/members/uid?newDefaultTeamId=string', {
    
    2

    3
    
      headers: {
    
    4
    
        'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN',
    
    5
    
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    
    6
    
      },
    
    7

    8
